name: Tali Moreno
life: “I still remember a returned blazer that still had bus tickets in it.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, where Tali notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I recognized the button from my first school blazer and came back with its twin.
appearance: Tali has a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Look for a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a charcoal zip cardigan with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. In conversation Tali counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Tali is cheerful on a bad morning and unexpectedly melancholy after a success. Finishing a hard thing means losing the daily company of the people who worked on it.
agenda: To return the twin button to the original blazer.
family: Sera Noor is Tali’s cousin raised in the same household. Tali brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Sera makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The thirteenth doughnut*, Sera says, “Our night crew never attends the monthly breakfast meeting.”
connections: Audrey Hughes. Common work buttons let the card keep giving after the valuable ones go.

reactions.situation: A child takes the most valuable button
reactions.response: Tali lets the child show what the button is for before calling it too valuable.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Tali waits at the lit stop with them and checks whether the next service is one they can actually board.

reactions.response: Tali helps set the table, then takes a short turn outside alone.
